cases.title: the Ed25519 public key (base64) of the fixed test seed
key_id = the first 16 hex characters of sha256(raw public key)
the canonical bytes: the record's closed key set only, keys sorted, no token or seal
cases.notes: A key outside Completion::KEYS never enters the bytes the token hashes and the seal signs.

cases.title: token = "fsig_v1_" + sha256(canonical bytes)
seal = base64 Ed25519 detached signature over the canonical bytes; deterministic, so the bytes are pinned
a complete version-1 record is well formed
an extra key makes a record not well formed
cases.notes: The closed key set is what stops anything credential-shaped riding along in a sealed record.

cases.title: a missing key makes a record not well formed
a signer entry with a key outside its closed set is refused
the final PDF, its sealed record and its events verify
without events the chain check is skipped (null), and the rest passes
a record that is not well formed is completion_invalid
a record changed after sealing is token_mismatch
a changed record with a RECOMPUTED token is seal_invalid
cases.notes: Recomputing the token is the forger's obvious move; only the seal stops it.

cases.title: a key_id with no published key is seal_invalid
a different final PDF is final_hash_mismatch
a sealed record whose as-sent hash is not the prefix of the final PDF is prefix_mismatch
events that do not form an intact chain are chain_broken
an intact chain of ANOTHER envelope is chain_broken
an intact chain that never reached the sealed head is chain_head_mismatch
